name: Setmelanotide
description: Injected peptide that switches on the melanocortin 4 (MC4) receptor, a brain hunger-control receptor

note.text: The label says it is not approved for common (polygenic) obesity and would not be expected to help there.

bullets: **MC4 receptor agonist,** with 20-fold less activity at MC3 and MC1 (label)
**MC4 receptors** in the brain help regulate hunger, fullness and energy use
**Based on nonclinical evidence,** may restore MC4 pathway activity
**Weak MC1 action** in skin pigment cells darkens the skin in many people

notEstablished.text: PK over 65 or in liver disease

practical.routes: Injection under the skin, once daily
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak about 8 hours; broken down into small peptides
practical.monitored: Skin and moles, mood; adrenal and sodium issues in HO

references: Clément et al., POMC and LEPR Phase 3 trials, Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol, Dec 2020
Miller et al., TRANSCEND, N Engl J Med, Jul 2026
